items.title: Gazans return after Israel army ends rare ground operation
items.summary: Weary Palestinians returned to check their belongings and assess the damage in central Gaza on Thursday, after the Israeli military said it had completed a ground operation it began the day before. The military had launched the incursion involving tanks despite a ceasefire which came into effect in October 2025, saying it aimed to "dismantle a terror tunnel" that posed a threat to troops.
